Replicating Davidsson and Honig (2003): Updates on Human Capital, Social Capital, and Replications in Entrepreneurship
Vitaliy Skorodziyevskiy, G. Christopher Crawford, Nathan T. Hayes, Per Davidsson, Benson Honig
Abstract
We conducted a three-step replication of Davidsson and Honig’s study on the roles of human and social capital in venture creation processes.
